answer: Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. Forging 566 of these means building 566 separate yield records from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The defence rests on orchard society membership with harvest yield records: yields recorded for one orchard across years. Watch the lantern: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the grove bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the thread audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
